description: PocketCsvReader.Markdown extends PocketCsvReader with a streaming reader for GitHub Flavored Markdown pipe tables.
The .NET measurement command for Ratchet's test suite measurement: it runs a solution's tests and writes a measurement in Ratchet's measurement contract.
Translations for any .NET app, written in C#: a class per language, or one-line texts, where a missing translation is a compile error. No resource files, no reflection, trimming-safe.
Olve.WebGPU in the browser: links Emscripten's emdawnwebgpu port into a .NET WebAssembly app (needs the wasm-tools workload of .NET 11 or later).
A faithful C# mapping of WebGPU, generated from Dawn's webgpu.h. Callers need no unsafe code. Reference Olve.WebGPU.Native (desktop) or Olve.WebGPU.Browser (WebAssembly) for the implementation.
